data.name: Kinetic Displacement Mitigation
data.description: Provides 50% damage resistance to fire, allowing bearer to rest assured in their inflammability. Gives the wearer a 50% chance to avoid grievous limb injury. Reduces damage taken from impact and collisions by 30%.
